subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should Auto-TTS and normal messages.tts synthesis preserve automatic fallback from the selected provider to other configured providers, or should a configured provider fail closed unless the user explicitly asks for fallback?
rationale: Current code, docs, and tests intentionally preserve fallback behavior, while the issue asks for provider stickiness after a confusing ElevenLabs-to-OpenAI result; automation cannot choose that compatibility tradeoff safely.

options.title: Keep fallback default
options.body: Preserve the documented fallback chain and consider a future explicit strict/sticky mode only with maintainer sponsorship and upgrade docs.

options.title: Make selected provider sticky
options.body: Change normal TTS synthesis to fail closed on the configured provider and update docs/tests to treat fallback as opt-in or directive-only behavior.

options.title: Close as designed
options.body: Keep the current diagnostics and fallback behavior as the supported product behavior, and ask for a new issue only with evidence that successful ElevenLabs audio is discarded after synthesis.

recommendation.title: Keep fallback default
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented fallback chain and consider a future explicit strict/sticky mode only with maintainer sponsorship and upgrade docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete was mentioned in the issue discussion and recently authored related TTS configuration work, making them the best available routing candidate for the product-policy choice.
